_comment: Benchmark suites for tools/bench/run.py. kind=gbench runs a Google Benchmark binary with the profile's repetition settings; kind=timeline runs a custom tool that writes its own JSON. env values are passed through ("auto" = the binary's own default, e.g. thread ladder up to hardware concurrency).

baseline.description: Storage-model baseline: all designs, micro scenarios (FINDINGS: baseline, H1)

fusion.description: H7 fusion: sequential vs fused vs hand-merged

fusion-exec.description: Fusion extension points: planners x executors

skirmish.description: Skirmish RTS: ms/tick per design with per-system counters

threads.description: H8 thread scaling on Skirmish (thread ladder up to hardware concurrency)

dynamic.description: H9 dynamic system timeline (stall vs incremental relayout)

quick.description: Smoke run: correctness of the harness, not numbers

standard.description: What the spike results were produced with (shared VM)

reference.description: Dedicated hardware: more repetitions, longer runs, larger sizes
